root_cause.text: Off-by-one error in the whitespace-stripping loop in `init_card()` where the loop bound `len < sizeof(card->id)` (16) fails to reserve a byte for the null terminator, allowing up to 16 non-space characters to fill the local 16-byte `id` buffer and overwrite the terminating null byte, resulting in a non-null-terminated string that later triggers a stack out-of-bounds read in `copy_valid_id_string()`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the loop bound from `sizeof(card->id)` to `sizeof(card->id) - 1` to ensure at least one byte remains for the null terminator. The commit message and CVE description explicitly state that writing 16 non-space characters fills the entire buffer and overwrites the null byte, causing KASAN stack-out-of-bounds when the non-null-terminated string is passed to `snd_card_set_id()`.

intent_record.how: This ensures that at most sizeof(card->id)-1 characters are copied into the id array, leaving at least one byte for a null terminator, preventing a potential buffer overflow or missing null termination.
